hero.title: Your signature smile, crafted in Antalya & Istanbul
hero.subtitle: Dental implants, veneers and smile design — with a free initial consultation and full support for international patients.

treatments.title: Treatments focused on your smile
treatments.lead: Every treatment starts with a free initial consultation, so you understand your options before you decide.
treatments.implants: A titanium post placed in the jawbone replaces the missing root and supports a new crown — a fixed solution for one or more missing teeth.
treatments.veneers: Thin, custom-made shells bonded to the front surface of the teeth to refine their shape, colour and proportions.
treatments.smileDesign: A planned approach to your smile as a whole — tooth shape, colour and balance with your face — before any treatment begins.

why.title: Care that is planned around you
why.link: How it works for international patients

items.title: All three treatments, in both cities
items.text: Implants, veneers and smile design are offered in Antalya and in Istanbul.

items.title: We speak your language
items.text: Talk with us in Persian, English, German or Turkish — on WhatsApp or by phone.

items.title: Assessment before you travel
items.text: Send photos or X-rays on WhatsApp and we review them online before you plan your trip.

items.title: Your trip, coordinated

items.title: Follow-up after treatment
items.text: We stay in touch after your treatment. A guarantee applies; its terms depend on the treatment and are explained in your consultation.

journey.title: From your first message to your treatment in Türkiye
journey.lead: A clear path for patients travelling from abroad, with coordination at every step.

steps.title: Request your free consultation
steps.text: Send the form or message us on WhatsApp — in your language.

steps.title: Online assessment
steps.text: Send photos or X-rays on WhatsApp; we review them and talk you through your options.

steps.title: Receive your treatment package
steps.text: Your package brings your treatment and travel arrangements together.

steps.title: Travel with coordination
steps.text: Hotel, airport transfer and interpreter are arranged for you. Most visits take 3 to 8 days, depending on your treatment.

steps.title: Treatment and follow-up
steps.text: Your treatment takes place at JOKAR DENTAL in Antalya or Istanbul — and we follow up afterwards.

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. Your initial consultation is free of charge.

items.q: In which cities do you treat patients?
items.a: In Antalya and Istanbul. Dental implants, veneers and smile design are offered in both cities.
We talk with every patient in their own language. You can reach us in Persian, English, German or Turkish.

items.q: Can you assess my case before I travel?
items.a: Yes. Send photos or X-rays on WhatsApp and we review them online before you plan your trip. The dentist confirms your treatment plan in person.

items.q: How long will I need to stay?
items.a: Most visits take 3 to 8 days, depending on your treatment. We tell you what to expect once we have reviewed your case.

items.q: Do you help with the hotel and airport transfer?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate hotel accommodation and airport transfers for international patients.
Yes. An interpreter is available for international patients.

items.q: Do you follow up after treatment, and is there a guarantee?
items.a: Yes. We follow up after your treatment, and a guarantee applies. Its terms depend on the treatment and are explained in your consultation.
Send the consultation form on this page or message us on WhatsApp. Our team will get back to you.

consultation.title: Begin with a free consultation
consultation.lead: Tell us a little about what you need. Our team will contact you through the channel you prefer.
next: Our team contacts you to understand your needs.
We plan your free consultation together.
